question: On the IDX, which information available at the close of a session distinguishes names that reprice +30% / +50% / +100% within the next five sessions from similar names on the same session?

event.price_series: reference-chain level: cumulative product of close/previous on every present session, with previous = IDX reference price (IDX resets it on corporate-action ex-dates, so splits and rights issues do not create price jumps)
event.decision_cutoff: close of session t (all inputs through that close)
event.forward_return: R5max(t) = max over k = 1..5 of level(t+k) / level(t) - 1, market sessions, closes only; sessions where the name is absent are skipped; no forward close at all = ineligible
event.episode: an episode at threshold X starts on an eligible ticker-day t with R5max(t) >= X when no session t-5..t-1 of that name had R5max >= X; its peak is the session of the maximum close within t+1..t+5
event.secondary_measures: R5 close-to-close return at t+5; executable entry = close of t+1 when traded and not locked at ARA; capturable return = max close t+2..t+5 / close t+1 - 1

eligible_if: session t lies in a research period and t+5 lies in the same period (5-session embargo at each boundary)
the name traded on t (volume > 0, close > 0, IDX reference > 0)
the name has at least 20 present sessions before t in the panel
the name has at least one present session in t+1..t+5
universe.price_floor: none; every price band is kept and reported separately

periods.holdout_rule: sealed: no label, base rate, signal statistic or detector result is computed on holdout sessions until a detector has been frozen and validated; then exactly one pre-registered holdout evaluation

first_100: the first 100 E30 episodes of the discovery period in chronological order, ties broken by ticker; no other selection

matched_controls.pool: eligible ticker-days on the same session t with R5max < 0.30, other names only
matched_controls.match_on: price band (<= Rp200 / <= Rp5,000 / above), liquidity quintile (20-session median traded value), market-cap quintile (close x IDX listed shares); all computed through the close of t
matched_controls.relaxation: if fewer than 5 names share all three buckets: drop market cap, then liquidity, then price band; level recorded
matched_controls.not_matched_on_purpose: volatility, momentum, drawdown and the day's own behaviour, because those are candidate signals
matched_controls.sampling: without replacement, numpy default_rng(seed = 20261008 + episode index)

definitions.rel1: ret1 minus the median ret1 of all names traded that session
definitions.volr: volume / median volume of traded sessions in t-20..t-1 (>= 10 needed)
definitions.valr: traded value / median traded value of t-20..t-1
definitions.freqr: number of trades / median of t-20..t-1 (mirror field; not available live from Yahoo)
definitions.rngr: (high - low)/previous divided by its median over t-20..t-1
definitions.cpos: (close - low)/(high - low); one-price bar: 1 if up, 0 if down, 0.5 if flat
definitions.vol20: std of daily log returns over t-19..t
definitions.up5: number of up closes in t-4..t
definitions.zero20: present but untraded sessions in t-20..t-1
definitions.age: sessions since the name's first panel session (censored at 2019-07-29)
definitions.logval20: log10 of the 20-session median traded value
definitions.logmcap: log10 of close x listed shares
definitions.ara: close locked at the ARA limit
definitions.brk60: level above the max of t-60..t-1
definitions.ign: ASTRA IGNITION v1 thresholds on daily bars (ret1 >= 3%, rel1 >= 1.5 pp, volr >= 3); an analogue, not the 5-minute v1 detector

weak_signals.statistics: per signal: median in events and in controls; AUC = P(event value > control value) + 0.5 P(tie) over event-control pairs within each matched set; 95% interval by bootstrap over events (1000 resamples, seed 20261008); binary: rate in events vs controls

detector.selection_on_discovery_only: for each rule: n = flagged eligible ticker-days, p = share with E30, base = E30 rate of all eligible ticker-days; admissible if n >= 200 and the Wilson 95% lower bound of p exceeds base; select the admissible rule with the highest lift p/base, ties by larger n; if none is admissible, D1 = NONE
detector.freeze: the selected name is written into moonshot_e1.SELECTED and committed before any validation statistic is computed
validation_metrics: precision at E30/E50/E100 vs base rate (lift)

precision vs matched random controls: for every flag, a same-session eligible name from the same price-band/liquidity/market-cap bucket (relaxed as above), 200 draws; one-sided p = share of draws at or above the detector
recall: share of validation episodes flagged on a session of the episode while R5max >= threshold still held (before the repricing), with lead time to the peak
executability: share of flags with an executable entry at the close of t+1; capturable return
trading: the idxsig harness (lots, fees, ARA/ARB, corporate-action registry) over the validation window against its matched and same-session random baselines

claims: This is historical research. No result here is prospective performance, and a 100-event pilot does not establish predictive power.
